title: Large values of logarithmic derivatives of quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions
summary: In this article, we apply the resonance method to derive conditional Omega results for logarithmic derivatives of quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions. We improve a previous result of Mortada and Murty \cite{MM13}, as well as generalize some results of Yang \cite{yang2023omegatheoremslogarithmicderivatives}.
